sense: a slot the style prohibits outright
definition: The style prohibits this element outright: no option of it may appear, and nothing an ancestor says about it reaches the style. A Prairie house forbids most of the classical apparatus; a Creole cottage forbids a centred entry door.
more: Forbidding a slot refuses the element itself. Forbidding one option of a slot is a narrower statement: the element stays, and only that way of making it is ruled out.
